rationale: Both responses use the same sound two-step conversion (42 baps to 70 yaps to 40 daps) with the same correct arithmetic. The only difference is the verification line. A uses arrows to show the chain of conversions, which is correct. B writes it as a chained equality, '40 daps × (7/4) = 70 yaps × (3/5) = 42 baps', which read literally claims that 70 equals 42 and so is a notational error. That small flaw gives A the edge.
